description: fnpf_ting_kirby_spilling turned along y (4 cells across, B 105 90, generation line B 108, walls at x): the mean zero-up-crossing wave height along the flume against that of fnpf_ting_kirby_spilling_x3 (along x, 4 cells across, walls at y) in the same run (orientation of the model and its breaking scheme). Before NHFLOW Breaking patch 0007 the walls at x damped NHFLOW waves along y (H_max 0.150 m 1.7 m later without breaking); before patch 0006 FNPF generated cnoidal waves of 0.05 m in both directions.

reference.citation: Ting, F.C.K. & Kirby, J.T. (1994) Observation of undertow and turbulence in a laboratory surf zone. Coastal Engineering 23, 51-80 (spilling case H = 0.125 m, T = 2 s, 1:35 slope); breaking point x_b = 6.40 m from Derakhti et al. (2016) Table 1, see refdata/waves/ting_kirby_breaking/setup.txt
